mutations.description: TSan checker accepts the watchdog name anywhere in the report (old, loose rule)
mutations.old: watchdog_races = any(names.get(t) == WATCHDOG for t in racing_threads(report))

mutations.rationale: the watchdog must be a racing thread, not merely mentioned
